```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# ggtree 3.14 calls this helper, which was removed from ggplot2 4.0.
# Keeping the helper local makes the original plotting code work with either
# the older or current ggplot2 installation.
if (!exists("is.waive", mode = "function")) {
  is.waive <- function(x) inherits(x, "waiver")
}

library(tidyverse)
library(ape)
library(ggtree)
library(ggstance)
library(ggnewscale)

figure_dir <- "../figures"
dir.create(figure_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

## Load data

```{r load-data}
abundance <- read.csv(
  "../data/supp_4.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)

bray_curtis_distance <- read.csv(
  "../data/bray_curtis_distance.csv",
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)

metadata_cols <- c("sample_id", "clinical_response", "time")
missing_metadata <- setdiff(metadata_cols, colnames(abundance))
if (length(missing_metadata) > 0) {
  stop("Missing metadata columns: ", paste(missing_metadata, collapse = ", "))
}

sample_ids <- abundance$sample_id
missing_distances <- setdiff(
  sample_ids,
  intersect(rownames(bray_curtis_distance), colnames(bray_curtis_distance))
)
if (length(missing_distances) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Samples missing from the Bray-Curtis matrix: ",
    paste(missing_distances, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

bray_curtis_distance <- bray_curtis_distance[
  sample_ids,
  sample_ids,
  drop = FALSE
]

tree <- bray_curtis_distance %>%
  as.dist() %>%
  hclust(method = "ward.D2") %>%
  as.phylo()

meta <- abundance %>%
  transmute(
    label = sample_id,
    group_plot = case_when(
      clinical_response == "donor" ~ "donor",
      time == "T0" ~ "recipient T0",
      time == "T6" & clinical_response == "non-responder" ~
        "recipient_T6_non_responder",
      time == "T6" & clinical_response == "responder" ~
        "recipient_T6_responder",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group_plot = factor(
      group_plot,
      levels = c(
        "donor",
        "recipient T0",
        "recipient_T6_non_responder",
        "recipient_T6_responder"
      )
    )
  )

if (anyNA(meta$group_plot)) {
  stop("One or more samples could not be assigned to a plotting group.")
}

taxa_cols <- setdiff(colnames(abundance), metadata_cols)
taxonomies <- abundance %>%
  select(sample_id, all_of(taxa_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(taxa_cols),
    names_to = "Taxon",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(Abundance), Abundance > 0) %>%
  transmute(
    label = sample_id,
    Taxon,
    Abundance = Abundance * 100
  )
```

## Supplementary Figure 4

```{r supplementary-figure-4, fig.width=10, fig.height=16}
supplementary_figure_4 <- ggtree(tree) %<+% meta +
  geom_tippoint(
    aes(fill = group_plot),
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    size = 2.5,
    stroke = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_tiplab(
    aes(color = group_plot),
    size = 3,
    show.legend = FALSE,
    offset = 0.05
  ) +
  scale_fill_discrete(name = "group_plot") +
  scale_color_discrete(guide = "none") +
  new_scale_fill()

supplementary_figure_4 <- facet_plot(
  supplementary_figure_4,
  panel = "Composition",
  data = taxonomies,
  geom = ggstance::geom_barh,
  mapping = aes(x = Abundance, fill = Taxon),
  stat = "identity",
  color = "black",
  linewidth = 0.2
)

supplementary_figure_4 <- facet_widths(
  supplementary_figure_4,
  widths = c(2.2, 2)
)

supplementary_figure_4

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(figure_dir, "supplementary_figure_4.png"),
  plot = supplementary_figure_4,
  width = 10,
  height = 16,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
```
